name: Werple
summary: One of WA's earliest ISPs (werple.net.au from Nov 1996); fate unverified (MIRA NETWORKING PTY LTD (later PACNET INTERNET (A) PTY LTD), ACN 085 213 690).

events.details: Defunct. Content ends between Mar and Apr 2003 with a redirect stub, 404 by 2008 - proposal's 2003 verified rather than c. 2002.

refs.label: Last real page: Pacific Internet customer homepage directory, Mar 2003.
From 6 Apr 2003 the domain is only a redirect stub (served to Feb 2005).
ABR: MIRA NETWORKING PTY LTD (later PACNET INTERNET (A) PTY LTD)
Verified: werple.net.au's own 1996-97 captures are Mira Networking pages — the domain's operator (contradicting the project's Perth label)
ABR verified: the company (renamed Pacnet) carried the MIRA NETWORKING trading name from Apr 2000
